title: lobelia alata var. minor
intro: Lobelia alata var. minor, commonly known as Lobelia minor, is a species of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae, native to Australia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia minor include its expectorant and bronchodilatory effects, which can help relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Lobelia minor include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
